_comment: Plates we ship that are NOT byte-for-byte the CAA's file, with the upstream file each was derived from. aip-drift.py reads this: a derived plate whose source hash is still in the index is current (our transform, not staleness), and one whose source hash has gone is genuinely stale and must be re-derived. Without it a derived plate can never hash-match and sits in the drift report forever, mislabelled.
